title: Village association plan to stop using injection wells
summary: On April 23, testifiers urged funding for a regional wastewater system for a Maui bay, which an engineer said could cost $12.48 million to $16.14 million, and members discussed a resolution urging the administration to fund a loan from carryover savings. On April 21, a motion to delete $2.5 million for the village association's project failed 4–4. The mayor has pledged up to $9.5 million over several years, subject to council approval.
